subject: ddl: handle create writer error for index ingest operator (#53916)
summary: Reviewed the diff vs first parent focusing on add-index ingest pipeline error/metadata behavior. The new `ctx.onError(err)` on `Engine.CreateWriter` failure correctly cancels the operator pipeline and records the error, preventing the prior stuck/hang failure mode when no ingest workers can be created; the added failpoint/test only exercises this path. Checked later history on `upstream/master` for follow-up fixes in the same area; no remaining Blocker/High issue attributable to this commit.
